Guidelines

House Rules

🤫
Quiet Hours 10 PM – 9 AM. Please respect our neighbours. Disruptive noise after a warning is strictly prohibited.
📷
Security Cameras. Tampering with, covering, or disconnecting exterior security cameras is strictly prohibited.
🚭
No Smoking or Vaping inside the home, garage, or within 10 ft of doors or windows. Evidence of indoor smoking incurs a minimum $250 remediation fee.
🚫
No Parties or Events. Only registered guests on your reservation are permitted. Exceeding the guest count is strictly prohibited.
🐾
Quick Pet Rule. Pets are strictly not allowed on furniture or beds, must never be left unattended, and all yard waste must be cleaned up immediately.
⚠️
Enforcement. Continued non-compliance with house rules may result in your stay being cut short.
Waste & Recycling

Garbage Guide

🗑️ Garbage & Recycling
🗑️
Garbage
Place all garbage in the large storage container and bins located inside the garage.
♻️
Recycling & Cardboard
Please place all recyclables in blue recycling bags. Leave blue bags and broken-down cardboard beside the bins in the garage — our crew will handle the rest.
📅
Collection Day
Waste is collected by our crew. They'll notify you before entering the garage. Please do not place bins on the street.
🐾
Pet Waste
Pick up all pet waste from the yard and dispose in regular garbage bags before checkout.

Departure

Checkout Checklist

Checkout is at 11:00 AM. Cleaners arrive promptly — late checkout is not possible without prior arrangement.
1
Pick up all pet waste from the yard and dispose in regular garbage bags
2
Run the dishwasher if any dishes were used
3
No need to strip or make beds — leave as is
4
Return board games to the red cabinet in the upstairs family room
5
Gather kids' toys and books and place on the shelf in the upstairs master bedroom
6
Quick sweep for forgotten items — especially chargers and toiletries
7
Garbage: place all waste in the large storage container and bins in the garage. Recycling and cardboard can also be stored in the garage along the side.
8
Lock all doors and windows before leaving
